json.perspective: Prioritize fixes by frequency: start with Account Trust (6/8) to stop immediate business risk, next reduce onboarding friction (5/8) to improve activation and retention, then formalize Human Escalation (3/8) to resolve remaining high‑impact failures; each recommended build is intentionally scoped to be measurable and directly address the coded review counts.

gaps.title: Transparent account-health and appeal workflow
gaps.whyNow: 6 of 8 review excerpts raised account-trust concerns, making this the most frequently coded issue.
gaps.recommendedFeature: Account Health & Reputation Center — a unified in-app dashboard that displays verification status, sending reputation indicators (deliverability trends, complaint/spam-rate signals), automated alerts for trust-impacting events, and a one-click appeal/dispute…

gaps.title: Actionable, checklist-driven onboarding with pre‑flight validation
gaps.whyNow: 5 of 8 review excerpts referenced onboarding or usability problems that block time-to-value.
gaps.recommendedFeature: Guided Onboarding & Pre‑flight Checks — an interactive setup wizard with a prioritized task checklist, automated data/import validation, live sample-send preview, contextual inline help and a ‘resume onboarding’ path that records progress and surface blockers.

gaps.title: Fast, accountable human escalation tied to account context
gaps.whyNow: 3 of 8 review excerpts asked for better access to human support and clearer escalation outcomes.
gaps.recommendedFeature: SLA-backed Human Escalation & Case Management — an in‑product ‘escalate’ action that opens a prioritized case, shows estimated SLA timers and status, attaches relevant account-health diagnostics automatically, and offers optional scheduled callbacks for high‑…
